percentageRent.value: None. This is a flat-rent grocery anchor lease — no percentage rent / overage rent is provided.

exclusives.description: STRONG grocery exclusive (Art. III.3): Tenant has the EXCLUSIVE right within the Center to grocery, bakery sales, meat sales/butchery/meat market, seafood sales, sale of prescription drugs/pharmaceuticals, delicatessen, and supermarket use — EXCEPT a sit-down restaurant-style bagel shop or delicatessen dedicating ≥30% of its floor area to sit-down restaurant use. Art. III.5: while the Premises are used for the Initial Primary Use, Landlord will not grant any other Center tenant an exclusive that encumbers the Premises.

goDark.value: No continuous-operation covenant — Tenant must open as a fully stocked grocery store for ONE day on the Commencement Date and need not operate thereafter (Art. IV, X.2). BUT escalating Landlord termination rights on cessation (Art. X.3–X.6): (X.3) if Tenant ceases ≥1 year with no intent to recommence/sublease, Tenant must notify and Landlord may terminate within 30 days; (X.4) 1st cessation >60 days → Landlord's 'First Termination Notice', Tenant must give a reopen notice within 60 days and reopen within 180 days; (X.5) 2nd cessation >30 days → 'Second Termination Notice' (reopen within 60 days); (X.6) 3rd cessation >30 days → 'Third Termination Notice' (reopen within 10 days). Tenant must then operate ≥1 year after each recommencement.

assignment.value: Tenant may assign/sublet WITHOUT Landlord consent to (i) any national (10+ states) or regional (10+ stores in CO/UT/WY/NE/KS/OK/NM/AZ/TX) single-use retail tenant, or (ii) any subtenant/licensee/concessionaire ancillary to the Initial Primary Use. Any OTHER assignee/subtenant needs Landlord's consent (not to be unreasonably withheld/delayed). Tenant remains liable on assignment unless Landlord approves the assignee's financials and releases Tenant. Tenant may also mortgage its leasehold without consent (Art. XXIX.4).

camTax.value: CAM: Tenant pays its Proportionate Share (initially 32% = 65,575 ÷ total Center ground-floor + above-ground retail GLA) of Landlord's cost to insure/maintain/repair the common areas; estimated monthly, reconciled quarterly; 2-year audit window; Tenant maintains its OWN Premises (incl. roof) at its cost. Taxes: Tenant pays RE taxes on a separately-assessed Tax Parcel (Store Building + 246,455 SF land) if separately assessed, otherwise its Proportionate Share; Tenant may contest; refunds shared. No admin/management fee on CAM is provided.

leaseNotes.label: Security Deposit
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Use Clause
leaseNotes.value: Any lawful purpose EXCEPT: on-site dry cleaning/commercial laundry; bank/S&L > 1,000 SF (under license/sublease); and the 'Limited Uses' (office-supply/Kinko-type, and home-furnishings/domestic goods) limited to ≤3,000 SF display/storage each and ≤6,000 SF in the aggregate. Initial Primary Use = pharmacy, grocery and supermarket (with bakery/meat/seafood/deli and customary incidental services — banking, floral, dry-clean drop-off, postal, etc.). Must open one day fully stocked; no continuous-operation requirement. 90-day notice to change the Initial Primary Use (Landlord one-time recapture right if no restriction prevents the change).

leaseNotes.label: Radius
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: LL Radius
leaseNotes.value: None

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: STRONG grocery exclusive (Art. III.3): exclusive right in the Center to grocery, bakery, meat/butchery/meat market, seafood, prescription drugs/pharmaceuticals, delicatessen and supermarket use — except a sit-down bagel/deli/restaurant dedicating ≥30% of floor area to sit-down restaurant use. Landlord may not grant other exclusives encumbering the Premises during the Initial Primary Use (III.5).

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: None — King Soopers is the grocery anchor and has no co-tenancy/operating-co-tenancy clause.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: Landlord go-dark termination rights on cessation of use (see Go Dark); plus casualty/condemnation termination rights (Arts. XVII–XVIII).

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: Tenant termination rights on casualty ≥33% in last 3 years of any term, and on parking/access or ≥5% GFA condemnation (Arts. XVII.4, XVIII).

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center-wide prohibited uses (Art. III.4): no obnoxious odor; noxious/toxic gas (ex. gas-station petroleum); excessive dust; explosives/fireworks; hazardous substances (ex. compliant); warehouse/industrial; mobile-home/trailer court/junkyard; stockyard/animal-raising (ex. pet-shop pets); dumping/incineration; fire/bankruptcy/auction; auto/trailer sales/repair; mortuary; bingo; live-entertainment-primary; adult/x-rated/porn; adult theatre/arcade; massage parlor (ex. licensed medical); bar/tavern (ex. ancillary to restaurant); dance hall (ex. ancillary); health spa/studio (ex. ancillary to salon); car wash; bowling; skating rink; game parlor (3+ games); billiard/pool (ex. ancillary); shooting range; teen center; discotheque; video arcade (3+ machines); pawn shops. Landlord also bound by the recorded Declaration of Restrictions (Exhibit D), the Redevelopment Agreement Use Covenants (Exhibit E) and the REA (Exhibit F).

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Tenant must comply with use prohibitions burdening the Center under the Declaration of Restrictions (Exh. D), the Redevelopment Agreement Use Covenants (Exh. E) and the Reciprocal Easement Agreement (Exh. F).

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Tenant pays its Proportionate Share (initially 32% = Premises ground-floor SF ÷ total Center ground-floor + above-ground retail SF; adjusts with construction/demolition) of Landlord's common-area insure/service/maintain/repair costs (lighting, sweeping, landscaping, snow/ice, striping, security, etc.). Estimated monthly, reconciled quarterly with backup; 2-year audit window; Tenant may withhold if 2 quarters unreconciled. Tenant not charged for work on other buildings. No admin/management fee provided.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Tenant pays ad valorem RE taxes on a separately-assessed Tax Parcel (Store Building + 246,455 SF land) if Landlord obtains separate assessment; otherwise Tenant pays its Proportionate Share of Center RE taxes. Payment by joint check to Landlord + taxing authority. Tenant may contest (or compel Landlord to, on a 50%-of-floor-area petition); refunds shared pro-rata. Excludes Landlord income/franchise/transfer taxes.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Tenant carries property insurance on the Store Building/improvements at 100% replacement value (Landlord loss payee) + CGL $1M/person, $2M/occurrence, $250K property (naming Landlord and its mortgagee as additional insured), plus workers' comp; deductible up to $100K. Tenant may SELF-INSURE (net worth > $100M). Landlord carries common-area CGL ($1M/$2M/$250K) naming Tenant + its mortgagee. Mutual waiver of subrogation; A-X carriers; 30-day cancellation notice.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: No consent needed to assign/sublet to a national (10+ states) or regional (10+ stores in CO/UT/WY/NE/KS/OK/NM/AZ/TX) single-use retail tenant, or to a subtenant/licensee/concessionaire ancillary to the Initial Primary Use; all others need Landlord consent (not unreasonably withheld/delayed). Tenant remains liable unless Landlord approves assignee financials and releases. Leasehold mortgage allowed without consent.

leaseNotes.label: Alterations
leaseNotes.value: Interior/non-structural alterations allowed on notice to Landlord (with plans). Exterior, structural or material building-system alterations require Landlord approval (not unreasonably withheld; 10-day deemed approval). Tenant-made improvements become Landlord's property when permanently affixed; trade fixtures/equipment (Exh. C) remain Tenant's and are removable.

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: One day only (open fully stocked as a grocery store on the Commencement Date); no continuing operating covenant.

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: No go-dark restriction on Tenant, but escalating LANDLORD termination rights on cessation of use: (1st) >60 consecutive days → First Termination Notice (reopen notice within 60 days, reopen within 180 days); (2nd) >30 days → Second Termination Notice (reopen within 60 days); (3rd) >30 days → Third Termination Notice (reopen within 10 days); separately, cessation ≥1 year with no intent to recommence/sublease → Landlord may terminate within 30 days of Tenant's required notice. Tenant must operate ≥1 year after each recommencement. (Cessation for remodel/refixture being diligently pursued is excluded.)

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Monetary (Art. XXX): Landlord gives written notice; if unpaid 10 days have run, Tenant has 2 days after notice to cure; unpaid amounts accrue interest at the Default Rate. Landlord need not give a monetary-default notice more than 3 times/year. Non-monetary: Tenant has 30 days to begin cure and must diligently complete. Default Rate (Art. XII.1): prime + 2% (first 30 days), + 4% (next 30 days), + 6% thereafter (First Interstate Bank of Denver prime). Landlord default (Art. XXXI): 30-day cure; Tenant self-help/offset for monetary cures.

leaseNotes.label: Guaranty
leaseNotes.value: None — Dillon Companies (a Kroger company) is the tenant; no separate guaranty.

leaseNotes.label: Outparcel Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center has outparcels/pads (Site Plan; 'Pad N' excepted from Landlord's fee title at closing). Building envelopes fixed on the Site Plan; Landlord may not build outside them or alter the 'Restricted Area' (parking/access) without consequences to Tenant's rights.

leaseNotes.label: Purchase Option
leaseNotes.value: None — no purchase option or right of first refusal in the lease.

leaseNotes.label: Holdover
leaseNotes.value: Month-to-month tenancy (not a renewal); either party may terminate on notice per Colorado law. Holdover rent = 120% of the rent payable immediately prior to the holdover.

leaseNotes.label: Relocation
leaseNotes.value: None — Landlord has no right to relocate the Premises; building envelope/Restricted Area are fixed on the Site Plan.

leaseNotes.label: Utilities
leaseNotes.value: Tenant pays all utilities serving the Premises directly (gas, water, sewer, heat, electricity and all others). Landlord allocated 8 ×¾" water taps at construction.

leaseNotes.label: HVAC
leaseNotes.value: Tenant maintains the non-structural portions of the Premises INCLUDING the roof and HVAC at its sole cost, in first-class condition (Art. XIII.1) — unusually broad tenant maintenance for an anchor. No obligation to replace a component (incl. roof) within the last 3 years of the term if still functional. Tenant supplied a 'partial HVAC package' as a Tenant Purchase Item at construction.

leaseNotes.label: Pylon / Signage
leaseNotes.value: Landlord built two Center identification (pylon) signs (Colorado Blvd entrance + westerly Yale entrance); Tenant is reserved ≥25% of each sign fascia in the top area nearest the public street. Tenant may also build two monument signs (Amherst + easterly Yale entrance) at its cost, and install King Soopers building/ATM/promotional signage (Landlord consent not unreasonably withheld).

leaseNotes.label: Subordination / SNDA
leaseNotes.value: Tenant subordinates to Landlord's mortgagee ONLY if the mortgagee (i) is bound by the lease on foreclosure/succession, (ii) grants non-disturbance so long as Tenant is not in default, and (iii) does not seek to amend the lease. Self-operative attornment on foreclosure; no rent to mortgagee until written notice + proof of succession. Tenant may mortgage its leasehold without consent.

leaseNotes.label: Lease Certificates
leaseNotes.value: Lease provides for lease certificates / estoppel-type confirmations (Art. XLI; Commencement Certificate per Art. IV / First Amendment).

flags.issue: Rent roll's term/option schedule conflicts with the lease + Kroger's own notice — please investigate
flags.detail: The LEASE (Art. V) grants SIX 5-year options at the SAME terms, and Kroger's 11/19/2021 notice confirms the term is extended to 6/17/2027 with FOUR remaining options (fully optioned to 6/17/2047). But the April-2026 RENT ROLL shows the current expiry as 9/30/2044 with TWELVE remaining 5-year options running to 2099. The expiry date (9/30 vs 6/17), the current term-end (2044 vs 2027), and the option count (12 vs 4) all disagree. I double-checked the lease and the Kroger letter and they agree with each other; the rent roll's 12-option/2099 schedule appears to be an MRI data-entry artifact. Please confirm there is no side agreement I haven't been given, and correct the rent roll if not.

flags.issue: Rent roll shows a renewal rent step to $11.55/SF that the lease does not contain — please investigate
flags.detail: The rent roll lists option rent of $757,391.04/yr ($11.55/SF) at renewal. The lease sets rent at a FLAT $10.50/SF (Art. VI(4–5)) and provides that all six options are 'upon the same terms and conditions' (Art. V) — i.e. rent stays $10.50/SF ($688,537.50/yr) through every option, with no step. Current in-place rent ($688,537.56 in the roll ≈ $688,537.50) matches; the $11.55 renewal step does not appear in the lease. Please confirm whether a separate rent escalation exists; otherwise the roll's $11.55 option rent is incorrect.

flags.issue: GLA: lease body says 65,579 SF; as-built / rent roll is 65,575 SF
flags.detail: The 1996 lease body (Art. II) describes the building as ~65,579 SF ground floor; the 2001 First Amendment fixes the as-built ground floor at 65,575 SF, which the rent roll and rent math ($688,537.50 ÷ $10.50 = 65,575) confirm. Using 65,575 SF. (There is also ~5,041 SF of office/equipment/mezzanine area that is not part of the ground-floor rent base.)

narrative: King Soopers (Dillon Companies, LLC — a Kroger company; Kroger store #620-00072) is the grocery anchor at University Hills, Denver, occupying a 65,575 SF ground-floor store (plus ~5,041 SF of office/equipment area) under a 7/17/1996 build-to-suit lease that commenced 6/18/1997. Rent is a flat $10.50/SF ($688,537.50/yr) with NO percentage rent and NO escalation — it stays flat across the original 20-year term and all six 5-year options. Per Kroger's 11/19/2021 notice the tenant has extended to 6/17/2027 and holds four remaining options, so the lease is effectively controlled to 6/17/2047 at Kroger's election (auto-renewing unless Kroger affirmatively terminates on 180 days' notice). The lease carries a strong grocery exclusive (grocery/bakery/meat/seafood/pharmacy/deli/supermarket, ex. a ≥30%-sit-down bagel/deli) and is a true net-style anchor: tenant maintains its own premises including the roof and HVAC, pays all utilities directly, pays a ~32% proportionate share of CAM, and pays real estate taxes on a separately-assessed tax parcel. There is no continuous-operation covenant, but Landlord holds escalating go-dark termination rights if the store ceases operating. Two material items disagree with the April-2026 rent roll and are flagged for Eric's review: the rent roll's term/option schedule (9/30/2044 expiry with twelve options to 2099) and its $11.55/SF renewal step both conflict with the lease and Kroger's own records.
